activity-date.narrative: GHA 5 is a well-established organisation that was formed in 1994. While originally created to protect and promote HIV-related human rights, the organisation’s scope has expanded to also include broader SRHR. GHA 5 advocates for a holistic and rights-based system through diverse strategies in order to fulfil its mission to promote and protect health-related human rights. At present GHA 5 manages its interventions in several counties and is active on both national and regional levels. From 1 st October 2025 - 2028 GHA 5 is a core partner. RFSU is supporting GHA 5´s overall strategy; - Stronger Laws and Policies at County Level - Greater Access to Accurate SRHR Information Online - Enhanced Legal and Media Capacity on SRHR - Stronger Civil Society and Youth Movements
